methods.label: Evaluate the inner operation first
methods.explanation:
Evaluate the parenthesized operation first, using the stated definition:
\[
4\spadesuit 5=(4+5)(4-5)=9(-1)=-9.
\]
This result becomes the second input of the outer operation, so
\[
3\spadesuit(-9)=(3+(-9))(3-(-9))=(-6)(12)=-72.
\]
Therefore the value is \(-72\), choice A.
